note: Each vibe's hero: the library still of the object its card shows (src/xenoform/ui_static/vibes/<id>.jpg, made by scripts/vibe_objects/make_card.py from one frame of a finished cut, picks_thumbs.json and picks_cards.json), read from that cut's record at the card's time and checked against the card by picture on 1 Nov 2026.
